items.title: fix: interrupted triage leaves full-size SQLite snapshot copies in th…
items.summary: fix: interrupted triage leaves full-size SQLite snapshot copies in the cache (#193174) * fix: retire cancelled workers' SQLite snapshot copies When `openclaw triage` (or Doctor's in-process collection) is interrupted, the database-engine inspection worker task is cancelled while it holds a private read-only snapshot. Its cleanup runs, but every SQLite statement on the staging token, and the retirement of the copy's admission facts, goes through the worker's admission exchange. That exchange checks the task's cancellation first, so cleanup failed with "SQLite admission facts exchange cancelled by its caller" and the multi-gigabyte copy stayed under ~/Library/Caches/openclaw/sqlite-/ after the process exited. Add a settlement scope to the admission relay that keeps the caller's deadline but not its cancellation, and use it in the two cleanup primitives: the staging token's lock operations and admission-fact retirement for a removed path. Live readers still fence retirement through their own disk tokens. * fix: keep the admission-wait scope out of the worker relay import cycle Move the admission-wait scope (its store, deadline reader, cancellation check and the new settlement scope) into a leaf module. The staging token and admission-fact retirement import it there instead of through the worker relay, which closed a madge type-import cycle. The relay re-exports the helpers its existing importers use. Record the regression test's exact net test-line growth. * fix: list the admission-wait leaf in the PR wrapper inventory The PR wrapper extracts its import closure from scripts/pr-lib/wrapper-components.txt. The new src/infra/sqlite-database-admission-wait.ts is in that closure, so wrapper bootstrap and PR worktree provisioning failed to resolve it. * fix(sqlite): keep cancelled tasks from minting snapshot staging owners Cancelled cleanup only needs reclaim, release and retirement, so leave create-mode token acquisition outside the settlement scope. The regression test now stages the copy in a nested child directory whose creator exits first, so retiring the parent must reclaim the child after cancellation.

items.title: C++26標準化遇罕見挫敗，Contracts設計爭議成關鍵
items.summary: C++26國際標準草案未通過國際標準化組織（ISO）各國標準機構表決，新版標準發布時程面臨延後。C++標準委員會WG21成員Andreas Fertig指出，10月下旬結束的國際標準草案（DIS）表決未達所需的三分之二多數支持，主要爭議集中在契約（Contracts）功能是否已成熟到足以納入標準。

items.title: 日本外務省網站被駭3,600筆個資恐外洩，但強調非機要外交通訊
items.summary: 日本外務省上週公布，其可與外部通訊的網路遭第三方未授權存取，可能導致約3,600筆個資外洩，包括姓名、電子郵件地址等。外務省強調，這起事件未涉及處理高度機密資訊的封閉網路。

items.title: 法國國家血液機構冷藏設備遭網路攻擊，3處設施溫度控制遭竄改
items.summary: 近期歐洲冷凍冷藏設備遭網路攻擊的事件，已從超市與零售業蔓延至醫療機構。法國國家血液機構（EFS）於11月3日證實旗下3處設施的冷藏設備控制系統遭遇網路攻擊，攻擊者竄改溫度及除霜設定，企圖將冷藏設備調高至極端溫度。

items.title: Zyxel GS1900系列交換器存在越界寫入漏洞，攻擊者不需通過身分驗證就能執行作業系統命令
items.summary: 11月3日網通設備製造商兆勤（Zyxel）發布資安公告，GS1900系列交換器存在越界寫入漏洞CVE-2026-107441，該漏洞存在於交換器韌體的CGI程式，位於區域網路（LAN）內的攻擊者，可透過傳送特製HTTP請求觸發漏洞，進而在不需通過身分驗證的情況下執行作業系統命令，該公司已為10款GS1900交換器推出新版
